Definition
[Realizable lamination] 1. Definition 8.10.1\group lamination realizationSource: thurston:page-0223 For a map $f:S\to N$ from a hyperbolic surface to a complete hyperbolic three-manifold, a geodesic lamination $\gamma $ is realizable in the homotopy class of $f$ if some homotopic uncrumpled surface has wrinkling locus containing $\gamma $. Write $\mathcal R_f$ for the set of realizable laminations.
